usedFor: People you meet in Google Calendar appear in HubSpot as contacts without data entry.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event” in Google Calendar, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Meetings with new people are where contacts start, and “New Event” avoids re-firing on edits.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so a Google Calendar event with no guest email creates nothing.
